ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast binary distribution; high-intensity white pixels dominate the central 70% of the interior lobes, while low-intensity black pixels define the leading edge, lateral tips, and median vertical axis.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white regions in central lobes; solid black bands along the leading edge and distal tips; vertical black meridian line bisects the fluke from notch to peduncle; dense black mottling and striations radiate from the center towards the trailing edge.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped median notch with a calculated vertex angle of approximately 75 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations are present along the entire continuous trailing edge of both lobes, characterized by a jagged pixel-boundary with irregular peaks and valleys.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Outer edges exhibit an upward convex sweep toward the lateral tips; the trailing edge follows a generally horizontal but highly irregular serrated path from notch to tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Two high-contrast clusters of white circular pixel groups (approximately 6-8 per side) are located at the extreme lateral tips of the left and right lobes, consistent with barnacle colonization.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive network of dark linear pixel disruptions; specifically, multiple diagonal scratches on the left lobe and vertical parallel rake marks on the interior of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent surface scarring including numerous multi-directional rake marks and dense circular barnacle scarring at both fluke tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced dark vertical pigmentation band extending from the median notch downward to the visible water line.
